_meta._note: Placeholder tokens (LIVOS_REDIS_URL surrounded by double underscores) in this file are substituted at install-time by _dld_seed_mcp_servers helper with the host's actual REDIS_URL from /opt/livos/.env. installedAt is 0 because seed installs have no meaningful install epoch. Phase 219 T2: 15+ curated MCPs across categories (search, dev, files, productivity, system, database, web). Only `luse` + `sequential-thinking` ship enabled — operators opt into the rest via /settings → MCP. T3 added 4 local liv-* MCPs (system category).

brave-search.name: brave-search
brave-search.description: Web + local search via Brave Search API. Requires BRAVE_API_KEY.

everything.name: everything
everything.description: MCP reference server — every prompt / resource / tool primitive in one place. Useful for testing MCP clients.

fetch.name: fetch
fetch.description: Fetch arbitrary URLs and return parsed Markdown. Read-only.

filesystem.name: filesystem
filesystem.description: Read / write files under an allowed root (defaults to /home/bruce). Destructive ops gated.

git.name: git
git.description: Local Git repo operations — status / log / diff / branch / show. Read-only.

github.name: github
github.description: GitHub API — issues, PRs, code search. Needs GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.

gitlab.name: gitlab
gitlab.description: GitLab API — projects, issues, MRs. Needs GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.

google-drive.name: google-drive
google-drive.description: Google Drive — search + read files. Requires OAuth client config (see server README).

google-maps.name: google-maps
google-maps.description: Google Maps — geocoding, places, directions. Needs GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY.

kubernetes.name: kubernetes
kubernetes.description: Read pods / services / deployments from the host kubeconfig. Read-only by default.

liv-apps.name: liv-apps
liv-apps.description: List installed LivOS app instances + resolve slug → subdomain/port. Read-only. Needs LIVINITYD_API_URL + LIV_API_KEY env wired via the UI before enabling.

liv-docker.name: liv-docker
liv-docker.description: Inspect the host Docker daemon — list containers, tail logs, restart (destructive, gated).

liv-system.name: liv-system
liv-system.description: Read CPU / memory / disk / uptime metrics for the LivOS host. Read-only.

liv-vault.name: liv-vault
liv-vault.description: Note CRUD over ~bruce/livinity/<agent>/notes/. Write + delete are destructive (gated).

luse.name: luse
luse.description: Computer-use tools (keyboard / mouse / screenshot). System MCP — required for the WebApp surface.

postgres.name: postgres
postgres.description: Read-only Postgres queries. Edit the connection URL in args[2] before enabling.

puppeteer.name: puppeteer
puppeteer.description: Headless Chromium browsing — navigate, click, fill, screenshot. Heavy: bundles Chromium.

slack.name: slack
slack.description: Slack — list channels, post messages, search. Needs SLACK_BOT_TOKEN + SLACK_TEAM_ID.

sqlite.name: sqlite
sqlite.description: Read-only SQLite queries against a path you choose (edit args[--db-path]).

tavily-search.name: tavily-search
tavily-search.description: Tavily web search — designed for LLM grounding. Needs TAVILY_API_KEY.
